findings.summary: An accepted effect and verifier_error can coexist; verifier failure does not authorize replay or rollback.
Output columns, YAML shape, method-specific payload fields, command boundaries and identifier representation require distinct evidence.

evidence_coverage.limits: The reporter read source accounts, not original command bytes, logs or current device state. Corrections are source-reported; ECC activation/version and causal contribution are unknown. Separate mechanisms must not be assigned one root cause.

recommended_next_action.action: Repair the read/check contract while retaining accepted outcome; reconcile unknown effects before any retry.
